Sample.evidence_source: The Erikson Psychosocial Stage Inventory (EPSI; Rosenthal et al., 1981) was used. This measure consists of 12 items—six for synthesis (e.g., "I have got a clear idea of what I want to be") and six for confusion (e.g., "I change my opinion of myself a lot") rated on a 5-point Likert-type scale, ranging from 1 (completely untrue) to 5 (completely true).
